onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_c_mode to {{da_c_mode}}]
Set dash mode to {{da_c_mode}}: quick_burst=short distance+short cooldown, standard=defaults, long_lunge=large distance+long cooldown.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_c_physics to {{da_c_physics}}]
Set dash physics: kinematic=uses addMoveDelta (no residual momentum), momentum=uses addVelocity (leaves momentum after dash ends).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_t_distance to {{da_t_distance}}]
Set DashAbility.dashDistance to {{da_t_distance}} world units.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_t_duration to {{da_t_duration}}]
Set DashAbility.dashDuration to {{da_t_duration}} seconds. Combined with distance, determines dash speed.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_t_cooldown to {{da_t_cooldown}}]
Set DashAbility.dashCooldown to {{da_t_cooldown}} seconds. Time before dash is available again.
